events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. Elvis Presley left us on this day, but his music still reigns supreme. What's your go-to track from The King?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman still rocking it. What's your favourite track from her?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remember the iPod
angles.copy: Cast your mind back to 2001! On this day, Apple launched the original iPod. Remember carrying your entire music library in your pocket? What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating the iconic spy who first hit screens with 'Dr. No' today in '62. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His legacy continues to inspire generations. What's the John Lennon track that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 87th Birthday to the inimitable John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day. His voice and stage presence were simply unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' Released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showed their incredible evolution. What's your favourite track from it?
